card.summary: Quoted, translated from Russian: free products are limited to four services, CDN, Object Storage, Video Platform and Support. Base plans renew automatically ...

free_tier.stated: Quoted, translated from Russian: free products are limited to four services, CDN, Object Storage, Video Platform and Support. Base plans renew automatically every 30 days at no cost, but no compute product has a base plan.

egress.terms: 500 GB of free traffic on a paid server is a useful egress term and belongs in an egress record, not this one.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The free CDN tier is real and can front a paid or free origin, but it is not compute. Its value is in fronting, not in running anything.
record.limits_note: There is no free compute lane at all: the free plan covers CDN, object storage, video and support, while the cloud server product is hourly and paid.
record.binding_note: There is no free compute lane at all: the free plan covers CDN, object storage, video and support, while the cloud server product is hourly and paid.

evidence.proved: translated: base plans renew automatically after a 30-day period at no cost, and free services are named as CDN, Object Storage, Video Platform and Support, quoted
translated: "you can use the free services in four products: ArvanCloud CDN, Object Storage, Video Platform and Support Services", with cloud servers absent from the list, quoted
cloud servers are promoted with a 40 percent discount, free traffic up to 500 GB and hourly or daily billing, which is a paid product

record.notes: The site previously carried a URL at /products/vps/free which now redirects to the marketing homepage, which is why some lists still attribute a free VPS to Arvan. 500 GB of free traffic on a paid server is a useful egress term and belongs in an egress record, not this one. The registration identity step was not verified on 2026-10-22.
